Chat: A one-to-one or small group conversation, and the tab listing them
Channel: A named room many people and agents join
Thread: Replies under one message, shown beside the room
Agent: An AI helper that reads and writes in rooms like a person
Goal: A tracked aim of a room, split into smaller goals
Inbox: The list of mentions and replies waiting for you
Friend: A person you added so you can chat directly
Project: Shared work (code, issues) linked to a room
Mention: Calling someone with @name so they get notified
Huddle: A live voice call inside a room
Community: The group of people using the same Kuzz space
Pin: Keep a message or chat at the top
Mute: Stop notifications from a room or chat
Invite: Ask someone to join a room or Kuzz
